Carlos Medina's 2023 championship recap specifies a 15.5 g natural Sida coffee, 250 g water at a 1:16 ratio, and five 50 g circular pours separated by 30 seconds. It specifies 65 ppm water with equal calcium and magnesium, 91°C water, an Origami Air S brewer, and a 2:40 total brew time. The page frames the routine as repeatable because its dose, pour size, and interval are explicit.
